t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice was that the different gnomes can produce different points. Longer hats produce more than shorter hats, pink gnomes give more points than blue ones and green gnomes give more points than orange gnomes. This changes after every 4th break, so switch it up every 5th break. Get lots and lots of points.

vb_textbox.text: Try to keep count of how many rounds you've done and keep a mental note of patterns. Example - when choosing a gnome, pick pink, green or a taller hat. Then, every fifth round, switch and pick blue, orange or a shorter hat. There is no combinations other than pink or blue, orange or green or taller or shorter. So, look for the right one in those patterns.
